name: bt-linux-panel
description: 通过 MCP 操作宝塔面板：服务管理、站点与数据库诊断、防火墙审计与入侵排查。

description_i18n.en: Operate the Baota Linux panel through MCP: services, site and database diagnosis, firewall review and intrusion checks.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过 MCP 操作宝塔面板：服务管理、站点与数据库诊断、防火墙审计与入侵排查。

panel_public_ip.title: 宝塔面板公网 IP
panel_public_ip.description: Baota panel public IP (e.g., 203.0.113.10) — used in the MCP URL template. Leave empty if not connected yet.

bearer_token.title: Bearer Token
bearer_token.description: Authorization Bearer Token for the Baota MCP endpoint. Get it from the Baota plugin's '接入与体验' page. Treat as a secret.

instance_id.title: 实例标识 (Instance ID)
instance_id.description: Baota MCP instance identifier generated at install time (path segment after /bt-mcp-/).
